# Glossary {#sec-glossary}

Terms are defined here once and used consistently throughout. Add new terms in the same change that first uses them.

AIS
: Automatic Identification System — VHF-based exchange of vessel and navigational information [@itu-m1371].

ASM
: Application-specific message — application data carried in AIS binary messages [@imo-sn1-circ289].

AtoN
: Aid to navigation.

Binding
: The definition of how the semantic model is carried in one representation, and over each transport that carries it (Part III).

Class A
: A shipborne AIS station that meets the IMO carriage requirement for AIS [@itu-m1371].

Class B
: A shipborne AIS station not necessarily meeting the IMO carriage requirement, which transmits a restricted set of messages.
  A Class B CS station accesses the channel by carrier sense, a Class B SO station by self-organized time division [@itu-m1371].

CoAP
: Constrained Application Protocol — a web transfer protocol for constrained devices and networks, carried over UDP [@rfc7252].

Data owner
: An organization or person that originates a Thing or is responsible for it, and signs it with a persistent signature.

Event
: In Darwin Core, something that happens at a place during a period of time, such as a sighting.
  An event can contain several occurrences (@sec-vocab-observations).

Fidelity
: How completely a binding can represent a Thing.

Gateway
: An on-board component connecting a vessel's own networks to the framework.

GeoJSON
: A JSON format for geographic features [@rfc7946].

HTTPS resource record
: A DNS record describing how to connect to an HTTP service, including which HTTP versions it supports [@rfc9460].

IEC 61162-450
: Carriage of sentences over Ethernet.

IMO
: International Maritime Organization — the United Nations agency responsible for the safety of shipping [@imo-ais].

IRI
: Internationalized Resource Identifier [@rfc3987] — the form of every Thing's identifier.

JSON-FG
: OGC Features and Geometries JSON — an extension of GeoJSON [@ogc-json-fg].

JSON-LD
: A JSON-based format for linked data [@json-ld11]; the basic representation of Things in the JSON-LD binding.

Link relation
: The type of a link from one resource to another, such as `monitor` [@rfc8288].

Management area
: An area in which official rules apply to vessels, such as limits on speed.

MCP
: Maritime Connectivity Platform — a framework for maritime digital services, including identity registries that issue certificates to maritime organizations, vessels, devices and services [@iala-g1183].

MQTT
: A publish/subscribe messaging protocol in which clients exchange messages on topics through a broker [@mqtt5].

MRN
: Maritime Resource Name — a URN namespace (`urn:mrn:`) for identifying maritime resources [@iala-r1023].

Namespace
: The part of an identifier controlled by one naming authority, within which that authority defines terms or identifies Things.

Occurrence
: In Darwin Core, organisms of one kind and state present at a place and time; itself a kind of event (@sec-vocab-observations).

OneNet
: NMEA's standard for on-board networks over IP; link-local, carrying PGNs.

OSCORE
: Object Security for Constrained RESTful Environments — protection of CoAP messages end to end [@rfc8613].

PATON
: Private AtoN.

PGN
: Parameter Group Number — identifies a message type on NMEA 2000 and OneNet.

Private AtoN (PATON)
: An aid to navigation operated by a body other than the national authority responsible for aids to navigation.
  In the United States, any aid to navigation not maintained by the U.S. Coast Guard [@uscg-paton].

Provenance
: The record of who originated a piece of information and who relayed or transformed it.

Representation
: A family of messages or formats onto which a binding maps semantic concepts, such as sentences or PGNs.

Responsible party
: A person, organization or vessel to which a device's identity rolls up, in a given role, such as owner, charterer or master (@sec-responsible-parties).

Semantic model
: The framework's common definition of what information means (@sec-semantic-model).

Sentence
: A text message defined by NMEA 0183 (IEC 61162-1).

Server-sent events
: A one-way stream of events from a server to a client over HTTP [@whatwg-html].

Shadow
: A shore-side representative of a vessel, holding its state and acting for it while it is out of reach.

Shore station
: An AIS station on land, operated by the national authority responsible for aids to navigation or, under a private AtoN identifier, by another body.

SOLAS
: The International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea, whose Chapter V requires many ships to carry AIS [@imo-ais].

Thing
: Anything the framework describes, tangible or intangible — including relationships and schemas.

Transparency log
: A public, append-only log of certificates or signatures, which anyone can audit.

Transport
: A network or link that carries a binding's representation, for example NMEA 2000 or OneNet.

VDES
: VHF Data Exchange System.

Vocabulary
: A module of classes and properties for one domain (Part II).

WebPKI
: The public key infrastructure of certificate authorities whose root certificates are trusted by web browsers' root programs.

WebSocket
: A protocol for two-way communication between a client and a server over one connection [@rfc6455].
